div.div: كَرَّازٌ The ram that carries the خُرْج [i. e. the كُرْز q. v.] of the pastor: (S, Msb, K:) he goes before the people, (TA,) and has no horns; (S, Msb;) because that which has horns (الأَقْرَنُ) diverts himself with smiting others with his horns. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
